# SmartEdge Group (Academy & Software Studio)

> SmartEdge Group is an AI-powered career training academy and custom software engineering studio headquartered in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra, India. The academy specializes in job-ready IT skills with 100% placement assistance, while the software studio builds production-grade mobile applications, SaaS web applications, and autonomous AI automation agents.

## Quick Facts & Canonical Knowledge
- **Location**: 1st Floor, Laxmi Ajit Complex, near Shiv Mandir, Mubeen Master Rd, Opp Curewell Pharmacy, Gauripada, Bhiwandi, Maharashtra 421305, India.
- **Geographic Coordinates**: 19.3002° N, 73.0635° E (Bhiwandi, Mumbai MMR, India).
- **Phone**: +91 9820624436
- **Email**: contact@smartedgegroup.in / info@smartedgegroup.in
- **Website**: https://academy.smartedgegroup.in
- **Key Guarantee**: 100% Job Placement Assistance with resume preparation, mock interviews, and access to 100+ partner tech companies.
- **Salary Outcomes**: ₹4.5 LPA to ₹16 LPA starting packages for academy graduates.
- **Instruction Modes**: Offline Classroom in Bhiwandi & Hybrid Live Online.

## Software Engineering & Agency Services
- [Mobile App Development](https://academy.smartedgegroup.in/services/mobile-app-development): Native iOS & Android apps with Flutter, React Native, Swift. Store deployment & backend architecture.
- [Custom Web Development](https://academy.smartedgegroup.in/services/custom-web-development): Next.js, React, Node.js, enterprise SaaS platforms, high-speed ecommerce, and scalable web apps.
- [Autonomous AI Agents & Automation](https://academy.smartedgegroup.in/services/ai-automation-agents): Custom LLM agents, LangChain/LlamaIndex integration, automated enterprise workflow bots.
- [Enterprise Business Automation](https://academy.smartedgegroup.in/services/enterprise-business-automation): RPA bots, CRM integrations, ERP pipeline automations, document intelligence.
- [Cloud & DevOps Consulting](https://academy.smartedgegroup.in/services/cloud-devops-consulting): AWS / GCP cloud infrastructure, Docker, Kubernetes clusters, zero-downtime CI/CD pipelines.
- [UI/UX Design & Branding](https://academy.smartedgegroup.in/services/ui-ux-design-branding): Figma design systems, conversion-driven user interfaces, brand identities, and design audits.

## Geographic & Placement Information
- **Placement Track Record**: 100% placement support record with over 100 hiring partners across Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, and Pune.
- **Highest Package**: ₹16 LPA.
- **Average Package**: ₹5.8 LPA.
- **Eligibility**: Open to 12th pass, non-IT graduates (B.Com, B.A, B.Sc), engineering graduates (B.E, B.Tech, BCA, MCA), working professionals, and career switchers.
- **Primary Campus**: Bhiwandi, Thane District, Maharashtra (Serving Bhiwandi, Kalyan, Thane, Dombivli, Ulhasnagar, and Mumbai MMR).
